message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts.

Facts: On Aug 15 2015 1:20, defendant Zhang (张某某) was a passenger in a car driven by Li (李某某). They were traveling to a location, and a traffic accident occurred causing one death. Li fled the scene. At 3:00, Zhang was summoned to police, and during questioning he gave false statements / provided false proof to cover up Li's traffic accident and hit-and-run. So Zhang is guilty of providing false statements to police (i.e., false testimony, obstruction of justice). Also possibly "包庇" (concealing a crime) i.e., "包庇、窝藏" but here it's false statement to police about accident. In Chinese criminal law, "提供虚假证明、隐瞒犯罪事实" is a crime: "提供虚假证明、隐瞒犯罪事实罪". In examples, they used "窝藏、包庇" for similar scenario: first example: "张某某...帮助李某某...并随李某某逃匿...刘某某...陪同张某某到公安机关，谎称...意图帮助张某某逃避刑事处罚" answer: "窝藏、包庇". So they used "窝藏、包庇". Here Zhang gave false statements to police to cover up Li's hit-and-run. That is "包庇". Also possibly "交通肇事致人死亡" but Zhang is not driver. He is passenger, not responsible for accident. He didn't cause accident. So charge is "包庇". Could also be "提供虚假证明". In examples, they used "窝藏、包庇" for similar. So answer: [罪名]窝藏、包庇<eoa>
